quotes.title: Quotations
quotes.help: A quotation gives the customer prices without changing stock or accounts. Make it a bill when they buy.
quotes.newHelp: Quotation: priced like a bill, but stock, the customer's balance and GST returns do not change. Make it a bill from Billing → Quotations.
quotes.confirmCancel: Cancel quotation {{no}}? It can no longer become a bill.
quotes.convertHelp: The bill uses today's rates. Tick the box to keep the rates you quoted. Stock and the customer's balance change only now.
quotes.ratesChanged: Some rates have changed since the quotation.

print.title: Quotation
print.note: This is a quotation, not a bill. Prices may change after the date above.
